prerequisites.title: Before you start

items.program: An active program with its product website filled in (Programs → New program).
items.affiliate: At least one approved affiliate — only approved participations earn commissions.
items.keys: The publishable key and the secret key, generated under Integrations.
items.access: Access to your site's HTML and your backend code.

prerequisites.keysOnceBody: A key is only displayed when it is generated. Keep the secret one in a secrets manager; if you lose it, generate a new one (the previous key stops working immediately).

installTracker.title: Install the tracker on your site
installTracker.lead: Paste the tag before {head} on every page your affiliates link to. Use the publishable key.

details.params: Looks for the referral code in the <params></params> URL parameters.
details.cookie: Stores a visitor id (v_…) in the {cookie} cookie on your own domain for {days} days, with SameSite=Lax (and Secure over HTTPS).
details.send: When the URL has a code, sends the click to /api/track and exposes window.Referral.visitorId to the page.
details.noRef: Without a code in the URL it only renews the cookie — nothing is sent.

installTracker.testBody: Open your site with ?ref= followed by an affiliate's code. The click shows up under Affiliates, in the Clicks column.

identifyCustomer.title: Identify the customer from your server
identifyCustomer.lead: A click alone earns nothing. When the visitor signs up — or when you create the customer in Stripe — call POST /api/identify from your backend with the secret key. That links the visitor to the customer.
identifyCustomer.securityBody: Never send the secret key to the browser or call /api/identify from the front end. The route rejects browser requests on purpose: a customer id coming from the browser would let anyone redirect commissions.
identifyCustomer.visitorIdBody: The tracker writes the {cookie} cookie on your site's domain. If your backend handles sign-up on the same domain, the cookie already arrives with the request — read its value. Otherwise, send window.Referral?.visitorId along with the sign-up form.
identifyCustomer.responseBody: attributionsBound is how many open attributions for this visitor were linked to the customer. 0 means the visitor did not arrive through an active affiliate link.
identifyCustomer.stripeIdBody: A Stripe payment finds the affiliate through the Stripe customer id. Without it, the e-mail sent to identify is compared with the payment's e-mail: invoices carry the Stripe customer's e-mail; one-off payments only when they have a receipt_email. The first payment matched by e-mail stores the Stripe id, and later payments match by it. With neither, the payment is recorded with no commission.

fields.name: Field
fields.visitorId: Visitor id: v_ followed by 16 to 48 lowercase letters or digits.
fields.externalId: Your user's id (up to 200 characters). Repeated calls with the same value update the same customer.
fields.providerCustomerId: The Stripe customer id (cus_…). Recommended: the most direct way to link payments to the affiliate.
fields.email: The customer's e-mail, stored only as a hash. Without providerCustomerId, it is how a Stripe payment finds the customer — send the same address Stripe has.
fields.provider: Billing provider. Defaults to stripe, the only one integrated today.

connectStripe.title: Connect Stripe and receive payments
connectStripe.lead: The Stripe webhook is how IndicaFluxo learns that a customer paid. Each workspace has its own webhook URL and its own signing secret. Under Integrations:

steps.account: Enter your Stripe account ID (acct_…) and continue.
steps.webhook: Copy the webhook URL shown — it ends in your integration's ID. In your Stripe dashboard, under Developers → Webhooks, add an endpoint with that URL and select the events listed in Stripe events.
steps.secret: On the endpoint's page, reveal the Signing secret (whsec_…) and paste it into Integrations. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.

connectStripe.idempotentBody: Every event is verified by its signature and recorded exactly once. If Stripe sends it again, it is acknowledged and ignored.
connectStripe.currencyBody: A payment only earns a commission in the program's currency. A BRL program ignores USD payments.
connectStripe.verify: To confirm, send a test event from Stripe. Integrations shows Receiving events with the time of the last event; if the signature does not match, it shows invalid signature — almost always a secret from a different endpoint.

commission.title: How the commission is calculated
commission.lead: On a 30% program, a confirmed payment earns the commission below for the affiliate who owns the attribution.
commission.implementationBody: Money is stored in the currency's minor units (cents) and percentages in basis points (1% = 100). Rounding is always half-up on integers — never floating point.
commission.conditionsTitle: A commission is only earned when

conditions.currency: the payment is in the program's currency;
conditions.window: the first payment happens within the attribution window;
conditions.duration: renewals happen within the program's duration (first payment, N months or for as long as the customer pays).

lifecycle.available: Available — can go into a payout batch.
lifecycle.approved: In a batch — in a batch awaiting payment.
lifecycle.paid: Paid — the batch was marked as paid.
lifecycle.reversed: Reversed — a refund created a negative reversal. Nothing is deleted.

verify.title: Verify the integration
verify.lead: Walk the whole path with a test affiliate:

steps.click: Open your site with ?ref= and the affiliate's code. Affiliates shows the click.
steps.identify: Create a test account. Identify responds with attributionsBound greater than zero.
steps.payment: Make a test payment in Stripe for that customer. Conversions shows the payment.

verify.doneBody: A pending commission under Commissions means the click, identification, webhook and calculation all worked end to end.

attribution.title: Attribution
attribution.lead: Attribution decides which affiliate gets credit for a customer. Each program picks the model and the window.
attribution.windowBody: How many days may pass between the click and the first payment for the sale to count for the affiliate. Once the customer converts, renewals follow the program's duration, not the window. New programs start at 60 days.
attribution.firstClickBody: The first affiliate who brought the visitor keeps the credit while the window is open, even if another link is clicked later.
attribution.lastClickBody: The affiliate of the most recent click gets the credit, and the window restarts with every new click. This is the default for new programs.

holdPeriod.title: Hold period
holdPeriod.body: How many days a commission stays pending before it can be paid. It covers refunds: if the payment is refunded during this period, the commission is reversed before anyone is paid. New programs start at 30 days.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.lead: Each workspace has two kinds of key, generated under Integrations.

uses.clicks: Only records clicks; it cannot read or change data.

uses.env: In environment variables — never in the repository or the browser bundle.

apiKeys.rotateTitle: Generating a new key invalidates the old one
apiKeys.rotateBody: The switch is immediate. Update the tracker (publishable key) or your server variables (secret key) right after.

webhookEvents.title: Stripe events
webhookEvents.lead: Subscribe to these events on the webhook endpoint. Other events are received and ignored.

types.payment: Invoice payment → may earn a commission
types.oneOffPayment: One-off payment (no invoice) → may earn a commission
types.refund: Refund, partial included → proportional commission reversal
types.chargeback: Dispute → reversal proportional to the disputed amount
types.paymentLink: Links the invoice to the payment that paid it → refunds and disputes find the commission

errors.title: Errors
errors.lead: The APIs respond with JSON {json} and the matching HTTP status.

items.missing_credentials: The Authorization: Bearer header was not sent.
items.unauthorized: The key is malformed, invalid or not a secret key.
items.invalid_payload: The body is not valid JSON for the contract.
items.unknown_key: Tracker: the publishable key belongs to no workspace.
items.invalid_ref: Tracker: the referral code has an invalid format.
items.internal_error: Unexpected failure on our side. Try again.

pending.description: Your link goes live once the program approves your participation. Until then, clicks show up here but do not earn commission.

suspended.title: Participation suspended
suspended.description: While your participation is suspended, this link does not earn commission. Contact the program owner to find out why.

rejected.title: Participation not approved
rejected.description: The program did not approve your participation, so this link does not earn commission. Contact the program owner if you think this is a mistake.

error.title: This page could not be loaded
error.description: It may be a temporary failure. Try again; if it keeps happening, go back to the overview.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This address does not exist in the affiliate portal.

draft.title: Program not launched yet
draft.description: The program owner has not opened referrals yet. Clicks on your link show up here, but they only count as referrals once the program is activated.

paused.title: Program paused
paused.description: While the program is paused, new clicks on your link show up here but do not count as referrals or earn commission. Customers you already referred keep earning commission as usual.

archived.title: Program closed
archived.description: This program has been closed: new clicks on your link no longer count as referrals. Customers you already referred keep earning commission under the program's rule.

defaultLink.missingDescription: The program owner has not set the product website yet. In the meantime, create a link with a destination.

program.name: Program name
program.descriptionHint: Optional. A short description of the program.

commission.title: Commission
commission.description: What an affiliate earns, and for how long after the first payment.

program.recurrenceLifetime: For as long as the customer pays
program.holdDaysHint: A commission stays pending this long before it can be paid, to cover refunds.

attribution.title: Attribution
attribution.description: Which affiliate gets credited when a visitor converts.

program.recurrenceHint: How long the affiliate earns on the same customer's renewals.
program.lastClickHint: Credit goes to the last affiliate whose link the visitor clicked.
program.firstClickHint: Credit stays with the first affiliate whose link the visitor clicked.
program.windowDaysHint: How long after clicking a link the first payment still counts for the affiliate.

advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.description: Who gets credit for a sale, and how long a commission waits before it can be paid. The defaults suit most programs.

program.websiteUrlHint: Where the tracking script is installed. Affiliates' default link points here.
program.durationMonthsHint: 2 to 120 months. To pay only once, choose “First payment only”.

confirm.title: Save these changes?
confirm.statusBody: With the status “{status}”, clicks on links are still recorded, but no new visitor is attributed to an affiliate — for every affiliate in the program. Customers already attributed keep generating commissions.
confirm.currencyBody: Commissions already recorded stay in {from}. After saving, only payments in {to} earn commission in this program; payments in {from} stop earning.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: The default currency applies to new programs; existing programs keep their own.
workspace.name: Name

createWorkspace.name: Company or product name
createWorkspace.nameHint: Your affiliates see this name. You can change it later.
createWorkspace.currencyHint: Used as the default for new programs.

createLink.name: Link name
createLink.title: New named link
createLink.nameHint: For example, the channel where you will share it. It appears in the link address.
createLink.destinationHint: A page on the program's website, starting with https://
createLink.campaignHint: Optional. Helps you group links, such as “black-friday”.

inviteAffiliate.title: Invite affiliate
inviteAffiliate.description: They don't need an account. We e-mail them an invitation and show you a link to forward. Their referral code is ready right away.
inviteAffiliate.name: Name
inviteAffiliate.codeHint: Leave blank to derive it from the name.
inviteAffiliate.createdDescription: {name} is in the program, with their referral code ready.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: The public key goes in your site's tracking code. The secret key is only for calls from your server to /api/identify.
apiKeys.revealWarning: Copy it now — it won't be shown again.
apiKeys.snippetHint: Paste it before {head} on the site your affiliates link to. It sets a first-party cookie and reports the referral code.
apiKeys.revealTitle: {type, select, secret {New secret key generated} other {New public key generated}}
apiKeys.snippetLocked: The full public key is only shown when it is created; the code you already installed keeps working. Generating a new one invalidates the current key.
apiKeys.snippetNoKey: Generate a public key to complete the code and install tracking.
apiKeys.snippetReady: This code already contains the new key. Paste it on your site in place of any previous code.
apiKeys.confirmTitle: {type, select, secret {Generate a new secret key?} other {Generate a new public key?}}
apiKeys.confirmPublishable: The current public key stops working immediately. The tracking code installed on your site stops recording clicks until you replace it with the code containing the new key.
apiKeys.confirmSecret: The current secret key stops working immediately. Calls from your server to /api/identify fail until you update the key.

empty.title: First step: generate your public key
empty.description: It completes the tracking code below and is shown only once, when it is generated. The secret key, for calls from your server, can be generated later.

apiKeys.adminOnly: Only admins can view and generate API keys.
apiKeys.snippetFirstStep: Generate the public key above to complete this code.
apiKeys.noClicks: No clicks recorded yet. After installing the code, open a referral link to test it.

batch.confirmBody: This records that you paid {amount} to {count, plural, one {# affiliate} other {# affiliates}} outside the platform. The commissions in this batch become paid and this cannot be undone.
batch.referenceHint: Optional. A transfer ID, bank reference or invoice number.
batch.cancelBody: The commissions in this batch go back to “Available” and can be added to another batch. No money moves, and a cancelled batch cannot be reopened.

stripe.description: IndicaFluxo receives payment events through a Stripe webhook to calculate commissions. It never moves money and never stores your Stripe secret key.
stripe.accountIdHint: In your Stripe dashboard, under Settings → Account details.
stripe.thenAdd: Then add this webhook URL in Stripe:
stripe.title: Stripe
stripe.disconnectHint: Disconnecting stops new commissions from being recorded.
stripe.disconnectBody: Events sent to this workspace's URL are rejected from then on, and new payments stop creating commissions. The signing secret is deleted. Commissions already recorded stay as they are.
stripe.errorTitle: The Stripe connection has an error
stripe.errorBody: New commissions may not be recorded. Check the webhook URL in your Stripe dashboard and connect the account again below.
stripe.adminOnly: Only admins can connect or disconnect Stripe.
stripe.secretHint: Starts with whsec_. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
stripe.secretMissing: No secret saved — events sent to this URL are rejected.
stripe.memberSetupPending: Stripe setup is not finished yet. Only admins can finish it.

steps.label: Stripe setup in 3 steps
steps.status: Step {index}, {status, select, done {done} current {current} other {up next}}:

webhook.title: Add the webhook in Stripe
webhook.description: In your Stripe dashboard, under Developers → Webhooks, add an endpoint with this URL — it is unique to this workspace — and select the events below.

secret.title: Paste the signing secret
secret.description: On the endpoint you created, reveal the Signing secret and paste it here. It is how we confirm each event really came from your Stripe account.

health.awaitingBody: The secret is saved. To confirm, send a test event from the endpoint in your Stripe dashboard — it shows up here as soon as it arrives.
health.failedTitle: Last event failed: we could not record it
health.failedBody: {type} arrived {when}, but recording it failed on our side. Stripe retries the event automatically; if it keeps failing, contact support.
health.rejectedBody: A delivery arrived {when} with a signature that does not match the saved secret. Check that you copied this endpoint's secret and replace it below.
health.errorTitle: The Stripe connection has an error
health.errorBody: New commissions may not be recorded. Check the endpoint in your Stripe dashboard and replace the signing secret.

affiliateActions.suspendBody: While suspended, clicks and sales through {name}'s links stop earning commissions in {program}. Commissions already recorded do not change, and you can approve them again later.
affiliateActions.rejectBody: {name} does not join {program}: their links earn no commissions. You can approve them later if you change your mind.

customRate.title: Special rate for {name}
customRate.description: Replaces {program}'s rate ({rate}) for this affiliate only, on future commissions.
customRate.descriptionNoRate: Replaces {program}'s rate for this affiliate only, on future commissions.
customRate.hintPercentage: From 0.01 to 100, with up to 2 decimal places.
customRate.hintFixed: In the program's currency, paid per sale.

inviteOutcome.alreadyLinked: {name} already has access to the affiliate portal. The new program shows up there, no new invitation needed.
inviteOutcome.accountExists: {email} already has an IndicaFluxo account, so no e-mail was sent. The next time they sign in with that address, the invitation is accepted. Send them the sign-in link below.
inviteOutcome.notConfigured: E-mail sending is not configured in this environment, so no e-mail was sent. Send them the link below.
inviteOutcome.rateLimited: The e-mail sending limit was reached, so no e-mail was sent. Send the link below, or try resending later.
inviteOutcome.failed: We couldn't send the e-mail. The invitation is saved: send them the link below.
inviteOutcome.hintSent: Send this link if the e-mail doesn't arrive.
inviteOutcome.hintNotSent: With this link they create an account with {email}, and the invitation is accepted once they confirm the e-mail.
inviteOutcome.hintLogin: They sign in with their existing account and the invitation is accepted.
